stories.title: UN Security Council condemns Houthi attacks on Saudi Arabia, backs Riyadh’s right to self-defense

en.title: UN Security Council condemns Houthi attacks on Saudi Arabia, backs Riyadh's right to self-defense
en.summary: The UN Security Council strongly condemned ongoing Houthi attacks against Saudi Arabia, including strikes on civilian and energy infrastructure that have caused civilian casualties. The council affirmed Saudi Arabia's right to defend itself against these continuing attacks.

stories.title: Saudi Civil Defense declares danger over in Riyadh and Al-Kharj after early warning

en.title: Saudi Civil Defense declares danger over in Riyadh and Al-Kharj after early warning
en.summary: Saudi Civil Defense lifted an early warning alert for Riyadh and Al-Kharj on Saturday morning after declaring the potential threat had passed. Authorities urged residents to continue following official safety guidelines.

stories.title: Saudi Civil Defense issues, then lifts warnings of potential danger in Riyadh and other areas

en.title: Saudi Civil Defense issues, then lifts warnings of potential danger in Riyadh and other areas
en.summary: Saudi Civil Defense issued and subsequently cleared multiple alerts for Riyadh, Al-Kharj, and the Farasan Islands early Saturday as Houthi attacks intensify. Witnesses reported hearing explosions in Riyadh during the warning period.

stories.title: Iraq lifts restrictions on civilian use of western airspace

en.title: Iraq lifts restrictions on civilian use of western airspace
en.summary: Iraq has returned previously restricted airspace in its western region to civilian aviation authorities, ending military-imposed limitations that had been in effect since 2016.

stories.title: Saudi Arabia condemns Pakistan mosque bombing that killed at least 16

en.title: Saudi Arabia condemns Pakistan mosque bombing that killed at least 16
en.summary: Saudi Arabia strongly condemned a terrorist attack on a mosque in Pakistan's Khyber Pakhtunkhwa province that killed at least 16 people and injured 57. The kingdom expressed solidarity with Pakistan against all forms of violence and terrorism.

stories.title: Saudi Civil Defense issues multiple alerts across seven cities before declaring danger over

en.title: Saudi Civil Defense issues multiple alerts across seven cities before declaring danger over
en.summary: Saudi Civil Defense issued alerts across seven cities on Friday night before announcing the danger had passed. The alerts covered Jeddah, Taif, Yanbu, AlUla, Khamis Mushait, Jazan and Abha.

en.title: Brentford stuns Chelsea with three goals in the Premier League
en.summary: Brentford defeated Chelsea 3-0 in the fifth round of the Premier League on Friday. Chelsea, managed by Xabi Alonso, won its first two matches before struggling in recent rounds with one point from the last three games.

stories.title: Bombing at mosque near police offices in Pakistan kills at least 21

en.title: Bombing at mosque near police offices in Pakistan kills at least 21
en.summary: A vehicle bomb detonated at a mosque adjacent to police facilities in northwestern Pakistan during a coordinated militant assault, resulting in at least 21 deaths and 80 injuries.

en.title: Iraq Reopens Airspace to Civilian Flights After Years of Military Restrictions
en.summary: Iraq has reopened its airspace to civilian air traffic following an extended period during which military operations restricted civilian flight operations.

stories.title: Saudi Arabia Condemns Terrorist Attack on Pakistan Mosque

en.title: Saudi Arabia Condemns Terrorist Attack on Pakistan Mosque
en.summary: Saudi Arabia condemned a terrorist attack on a mosque in Pakistan. The kingdom expressed solidarity with Pakistan against extremism and terrorism.

stories.title: At Least 16 Killed in Suicide Attack on Police Facility in Northwest Pakistan

en.title: At Least 16 Killed in Suicide Attack on Police Facility in Northwest Pakistan
en.summary: A suicide attack on a police facility in northwest Pakistan resulted in at least 16 deaths.

stories.title: ‎Saudi holdings of US T-bonds down $120M to $142.4B in July

en.title: Saudi holdings of US T-bonds down $120M to $142.4B in July
en.summary: Saudi Arabia's US Treasury holdings decreased by $120 million in July 2026 to $142.4 billion. The Kingdom maintained its 17th position among the largest holders of US debt, with long-term bonds comprising 77% of its total holdings.

stories.title: ‎Gold prices rise, silver jumps more than 2%

en.title: Gold prices rise, silver jumps more than 2%
en.summary: Gold and silver prices increased on September 18 amid Middle East developments and monetary policy considerations. The dollar index gained 0.1% to 100.37, while Goldman Sachs maintained its gold price forecast at $5,400 by end-2027.

en.title: Monshaat unveils 13 initiatives under National Entrepreneurship, SMEs Strategy
en.summary: Saudi Arabia's General Authority for Small and Medium Enterprises announced 13 initiatives designed to support SME growth and competitiveness across market access, financing, business environment, innovation, and data sectors.

en.title: System Gaps
en.summary: An opinion piece discusses household electricity consumption challenges in Saudi Arabia, exploring the potential and limitations of residential solar panel solutions in the local context.

en.title: Brent crude deepens losses, falls 2%
en.summary: Brent crude oil prices declined for a third consecutive trading session on September 18, tracking toward their first weekly loss in three weeks. Market participants were evaluating the potential impact of Middle East conflict developments on oil markets.
